items.summary: Recommendation: decline the Black Market Apparel capsule prototype for now and require a report-only unit-economics baseline first. AI usage cost was $768.80 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23, including $63.45 for Black Market Apparel; Amazon reported $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, but no site-level Black Market Apparel revenue is supplied. Portfolio revenue is therefore unsupported for contribution-margin, payback, or forecast claims. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because zero experiments have measured outcomes. Minimum evidence before production work: same-period site/content-level affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, eligible sessions, AI cost, infrastructure allocation, and other direct variable costs. Keep the capsule as a hypothesis only; do not deploy or spend until the baseline supports a positive learning case.
